title: Amazon brings Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 to Bedrock
summary: Amazon Bedrock now offers Z.ai’s 753-billion-parameter GLM 5.3 with compatible APIs, prompt caching and managed US and global cross-Region inference.
body:
## A Chinese frontier model reaches a major cloud

Amazon Web Services has made Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 available through Amazon Bedrock. AWS describes the model as a 753-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts system designed for coding, systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks.

The release gives developers access through Bedrock’s console and through OpenAI-compatible Responses and Chat Completions APIs, alongside AWS’s own Invoke and Converse interfaces. It also supports prompt caching, which can reduce repeated context costs and latency when agents repeatedly send repository instructions, tool definitions or long documents.

AWS lists both US and global cross-Region inference profiles, subject to Bedrock eligibility and regional support. That makes GLM 5.3 available within a managed cloud control plane rather than requiring customers to assemble their own serving stack or connect directly to a Chinese model provider. Bedrock also exposes standard service tiers for balancing price, speed and latency sensitivity.

The distribution is strategically important for Z.ai because cloud availability can turn a model release into an enterprise procurement option. At the same time, Bedrock access does not automatically establish parity with leading proprietary systems. Customers will still need to test coding reliability, tool-use behavior, latency, data handling and regional compliance for their own workloads. The model’s very large total parameter count also leaves infrastructure and pricing questions that the announcement does not fully answer.

## Why it matters

GLM 5.3’s arrival shows that model competition is increasingly being decided by where a model can be deployed, not only by who trained it. A leading hyperscaler is placing a Chinese-developed frontier model beside global alternatives, giving eligible multinational developers a more practical route to evaluate it while making cloud distribution part of Z.ai’s competitive strategy.
title_zh: 亚马逊将智谱GLM 5.3接入Bedrock云平台
summary_zh: 亚马逊云宣布在Bedrock提供智谱GLM 5.3，支持兼容OpenAI的API、提示词缓存，以及美国和全球跨区域推理配置。
body_zh:
## 中国前沿模型进入主流云平台

亚马逊云服务宣布，智谱旗下Z.ai的GLM 5.3已登陆Amazon Bedrock。AWS称，该模型采用7530亿参数的混合专家架构，面向编程、系统工程和长程智能体任务。

开发者既可以通过Bedrock控制台使用，也可以调用兼容OpenAI的Responses和Chat Completions API，同时还支持AWS自己的Invoke与Converse接口。GLM 5.3还支持提示词缓存：当智能体反复发送代码仓库说明、工具定义或长文档时，缓存有望降低重复输入带来的延迟和成本。

AWS列出了美国跨区域和全球跨区域推理配置，但实际使用仍取决于Bedrock资格、区域支持和服务条件。这意味着符合条件的企业可以在AWS托管的控制平面内使用GLM 5.3，不必自行搭建推理服务，也不必直接对接中国模型供应商。Bedrock同时提供不同服务等级，用于在价格、速度和延迟敏感度之间进行选择。

对Z.ai而言，进入云平台的战略价值在于，模型可以从一次发布变成企业采购清单中的实际选项。不过，能够调用并不代表它已与顶级专有模型全面持平。企业仍需自行测试编程稳定性、工具调用、延迟、数据处理和区域合规。模型庞大的总参数量也意味着基础设施需求和最终价格仍有待观察。

## 为什么重要

GLM 5.3登陆Bedrock说明，模型竞争越来越取决于“在哪里能部署”，而不只是“由谁训练”。一家全球云巨头把中国开发的前沿模型与其他国际模型并列提供，为符合条件的跨国开发者评估它降低了门槛，也让云端分发成为Z.ai竞争战略的一部分。

sources.title: Z.ai GLM 5.3 available on Amazon Bedrock

cat_take_zh: GLM 5.3的突破在分发入口：Bedrock让它成为跨国企业可直接评估的中国模型选项。
cat_take_en: GLM 5.3’s important upgrade is procurement access: Bedrock makes it a directly testable Chinese model for eligible multinational enterprises.
